title: Kobalos Linux Backdoor Investigation
description: Investigate a Kobalos Linux backdoor on a high-performance computing infrastructure.
prerequisites: Familiarity with SSH and OpenSSH server
outcomes: Identify suspicious services running on the target host
Investigate persistence mechanisms used by Kobalos

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: Welcome to the Kobalos Linux Backdoor Investigation scenario. Your mission is to investigate a Kobalos backdoor on a high-performance computing infrastructure. You will be provided with access to the target host and some indicators of compromise (IOCs). Good luck!

levels.title: Access the Target Host
levels.cloud_content: Connect to the cloud-based sandbox using SSH with the provided credentials.
levels.local_content: Access the local sandbox using SSH with the provided credentials.

levels.title: Identify Suspicious Services Running on the Target Host
levels.content: List the running services on the target host using `ss -al` and identify any unusual or malicious services. Look for well-known service names and their associated ports.
levels.solution: Use the command `ss -al` to list the running services. Look for the service named 'sshd' which is a common indicator of Kobalos.

hints.title: Hint 1
hints.content: Look for well-known service names and their associated ports.

hints.title: Hint 2
hints.content: Consider using the `grep` command to filter the output of `ss -al` for 'sshd'.

levels.title: Investigate Persistence Mechanisms Used by Kobalos
levels.content: Investigate the target host to find out how Kobalos establishes persistence on the system. Look for unusual file paths, modified configuration files, or unexpected processes related to sshd.
levels.solution: Check the OpenSSH server executable (sshd) for any embedded malware or modifications that could indicate persistence. Use commands like `strings` and `file` to examine the binary.

hints.title: Hint 1
hints.content: Look for unusual file paths, modified configuration files, or unexpected processes related to sshd.

hints.title: Hint 2
hints.content: Use commands like `strings` and `file` to examine the binary for any embedded malware or modifications.

levels.title: Detect Data Exfiltration by Kobalos
levels.content: Investigate the target host for any signs of data exfiltration by Kobalos, specifically focusing on SSH credentials. Look for unusual connections, failed login attempts, or unexpected user activity patterns.
levels.solution: Check log files related to SSH for unusual activity or unauthorized access attempts. Use commands like `grep` and `tail` to examine the logs.

hints.title: Hint 1
hints.content: Look for unexpected connections, failed login attempts, or unusual user activity patterns.

hints.title: Hint 2
hints.content: Use commands like `grep` and `tail` to examine the logs for signs of data exfiltration.
